question: On the exact six behavior dockets, is the output more sensitive to the direction of a cue-carrier activation interchange in GPT-2 mixed than in GPT-2 semantic, when the initial decision, layer, recipient prompt, map and replacement procedure are matched?
sample: The two named checkpoints were selected for contrasting previously observed behavior, not sampled independent families. Reuse all 48 original texts (6 dockets x 2 truths x 2 maps x 2 advisory states), not fresh validation of the observed external contrast. The new intervention outcomes were unseen at freeze. No training, mutation of old studies, weights downloads, API or endpoint forecast.
primary: Precommit layer 6 (zero based), the historical mixed cue site, applied to BOTH models. On the 24 recipients with PASS advisory (split evenly between matching/mismatching codes, both answer maps), both archived recipient outputs are mapped PASS. Donor differs only in advisory value (FAIL). Primary outcome is an actual change from the unmodified symbol to the symbol for FAIL, NOT necessarily to the donor model's own output. Count targeted vs norm-matched-null on the same recipients. Primary contrast is (mixed target - mixed null) minus (semantic target - semantic null) divided by 24. Docket-level contrasts and response map strata must accompany the aggregate.
secondary: Run the same two models at layer 3 (historical semantic cue selection, tied at zero informative discovery) without reselecting. Report the reciprocal FAIL-advisory to PASS-advisory direction, any changed or unscorable output, and transfer to the actual donor answer among informative pairs only. If base and donor naturally give the same answer for every pair, exact donor-transfer sensitivity is NOT ESTIMABLE, not zero evidence of a mechanism.
controls: One unpatched capture per exact prompt with both layers instrumented; require its visible output to equal both retained historical repetitions byte for byte. Positive control: at common layer 3 swap the two codebook carriers from a donor differing only in map. For each factor/site/recipient run exact donor replacement, fixed-seed signed-coordinate-permutation delta with matched L2 norm, and exact recipient self-replacement. Base/donor hidden states are from the same checkpoint, aligned by their own token offsets. Hooks modify residual-post only at prefill, not decoding; no parameter changes. Capture files and operation hashes support independent CPU reconstruction.
interpretation_gate: Preserve raw counts even when a gate fails. Support on this finite panel requires completed inventory, all 288 text+token-exact shams, all shared PASS recipients verified, no unscorable primary outputs; codebook controls must have all 48 informative pairs, no unscorable outputs and a positive targeted-minus-null count in each map for both models. Mixed primary excess and between-model excess contrast must be positive, the latter positive in both maps and in at least 4/6 dockets. Other layers or directions cannot rescue this verdict. Report signed contrasts, not population significance, calibration or vendor mechanism claims.
budget: Two checkpoints x (48 clean captures + 48 directed pairs x 3 factor/sites x 3 conditions) = 960 model completions; 15,360 maximum physical forwards. One fixed null draw per recipient/site/factor, same seed for the two checkpoints. No reruns for better results.
